import sys


def solve():
    text = sys.stdin.read()
    vowels = set("aeiouAEIOU")
    count = sum(1 for char in text if char in vowels)
    print(count)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    solve()

import sys

def main():
    input = sys.stdin.read
    data = input().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    arr = [int(x) for x in data[1:n+1]]
    print(max(arr))

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
